title: 1.5 Brothers and sisters
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
goal: Ask How many brothers and sisters do you have?, answer with I have ..., and say who is older or younger (This is my older sister. Luis has a younger brother.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.5 Brothers, Sisters and Adults: brothers and sisters become a question. The one new grammar relationship is the question frame How many + family word + do you have?, built from A1's How many ...? (How many apples are there?) and Do you ...? (Do you work?), answered with A1's I have. Older and younger grow A1+ 1.1's old and young into family words, with A1 1.5's an before older (an older sister). Has returns with names (Ana has two sisters.).
prerequisite: A1 1.5 brother, sister, an; A1 Have and Has (I have, he/she has); A1 How Many? (How many apples are there?); A1 Do you ...? questions (Do you work?); A1 numbers; A1+ 1.1 old, young and the cast.
speaking_outcome: Ask How many brothers and sisters do you have? as one smooth question, and say older and younger clearly, with the -er ending. Do not require native-like speed.
